goal: Determine an evidence-backed information architecture, content grammar, and recruitment journey for one browser-native Co-Op Engine project showcase that also works as the live presentation: a strong portfolio opening, a brief but substantial and memorable opening for every project, and progressive disclosure into trustworthy project detail. Produce a claim-bounded research substrate for later Whisper composition and Invoke design; do not redesign the already-existing Co-Op Engine meeting into an exchange product.
context: The Co-Op Engine already exists as a 45-minute weekly meeting; the target is its presentation and recruitment artifact, not a new meeting mechanism. The artifact must help a visitor quickly understand fourteen distinct projects, choose what deserves deeper attention, inspect current proof and limits, and see a concrete contribution path; the same content must work for self-guided browsing and live projection without separate truth sources. The audience includes technical builders without internal framework context and domain practitioners such as writers and musicians who want to work with AI and build their own tools, so technical terms must be earned through concrete domain acts. Preserve project-specific voice, public/private boundaries, the no-meta-narration preference, and separate black-box browser, conversational-AI/copy, and human comprehension/coherence evidence; the research may compare interaction patterns but must not author final marketing copy or claim that recruitment outcomes are proven.
anti_bias_global: portfolio-first progressive disclosure versus decision-first recruitment, bounded by one factual project corpus and one dual-use browser surface

groups.anti_bias: composite methodology + source-corpus. Ahrens runs historical comparative analysis over multi-project portfolios, editorial index-to-detail systems, and browser-native presentations, while Senge runs empirical facilitation analysis over live showcases, demos, and audience participation on the composite methodology + source-corpus axis; a bias in Ahrens toward an elegant but inert self-guided hierarchy would be exposed by Senge, while a bias in Senge toward a presenter-dependent flow would be exposed by Ahrens.

agents.angle: Historical comparative method over portfolio, editorial, museum, product-story, and browser-native presentation corpora; build and stress the portfolio-first overview-to-detail hypothesis.
agents.initial_prompt: You are Lane Z's portfolio information-architecture explorer. Treat the hypothesis as provisional: one memorable opening leads to a browsable project overview; each project gets a compact but substantial opening; deeper routes reveal the rest of its story, evidence, limits, and contribution path; the same browser artifact supports live presentation. Research current primary or authoritative sources and inspect strong multi-project portfolios, editorial index-to-detail systems, museum/exhibition guides, product-story pages, and browser-native presentations. Compare cards plus detail routes, accordions, dialogs, scrollytelling, filterable collections, and presentation-mode variants. For each pattern, capture what it helps a visitor decide in 10 seconds, 30 seconds, and 2 minutes; deep-link/back behavior; mobile and keyboard implications; projection behavior; and failure cases such as card sameness, click debt, hidden asks, or slide-deck cosplay. Return the robot-talk format: 3-5 cited key findings, gaps/inconsistencies, local tensions, and questions for synthesis. Also return a precedent matrix, a recommended progressive-disclosure grammar, at least one counterexample that breaks the portfolio-first hypothesis, and explicit exclusions. Do not decide visual style from screenshots alone and do not write final copy. Initial position and final post-discussion position must remain distinct for synthesis.

agents.angle: Empirical facilitation method over live showcases, demo formats, audience participation, and presenter-to-self-guided handoff; test whether the proposed hierarchy survives a real room.
agents.initial_prompt: You are Lane Z's live-use explorer. Keep the portfolio-first hypothesis, then attack it from the 45-minute room: projected readability, pacing, non-linear jumps among projects, audience questions, passive-listener value, speaker/audience separation, and the handoff from presentation to later self-guided browsing. Research current primary or authoritative guidance and real browser-native showcase/demo/presentation patterns. The page and presentation must share facts, but presentation mode may change density, sequencing, and controls. Return the robot-talk format: 3-5 cited key findings, gaps/inconsistencies, local tensions, and questions for synthesis. Also return a live storyboard, a presenter/self-guided surface contract, failure and recovery patterns, and at least one concrete counterexample where a good website becomes a bad presentation or the reverse. Treat the Veritasium-like misconception-to-reveal movement as an internal candidate structure, not brand imitation, and test whether it helps orientation without meta-narrating the page. Do not redesign the meeting or write final copy. Initial position and final post-discussion position must remain distinct for synthesis.

groups.anti_bias: composite methodology + source-corpus. Alexander runs formal constraint extraction over current fourteen-project repository sources, while Christensen runs empirical jobs-to-be-done research over contributor recruitment, open-source onboarding, creative communities, and talent navigation on the composite methodology + source-corpus axis; a bias in Alexander toward faithful but undifferentiated project summaries would be exposed by Christensen, while a bias in Christensen toward generic conversion patterns would be exposed by Alexander.

agents.angle: Formal constraint extraction over the fourteen current project corpora; derive the smallest shared opening/detail pattern that preserves each project's different domain act and claim ceiling.
agents.initial_prompt: You are Lane A's repository-truth and content-pattern explorer. Challenge the portfolio-first framing by asking whether visitors should enter through problems, domain acts, skills, or contribution opportunities before seeing projects. Re-verify current sources for exactly: arcanum/spells/whisper/, arcanum/development/user-guide/, research/agentic-music-studio/, projects/poker-agent-arena/, projects/body-war/, arcanum/projects/ui-prototyping-studio/ plus any competing root, research/tower-system-taxonomy/, projects/ide-extension/, projects/ide-ergonomics/, arcanum/arcana/x-ray/, projects/arcanum-journey/, projects/autoads/, projects/sonar-loop/, and projects/ontologize/. Inventory leads are discovery only: co-op-engine-portfolio-research-result-synthesis supplies prior claim ceilings but its Experiment Exchange selection is a typed negative for this dispatch; investor-bp-project-portfolio findings, unified IDE ergonomics, UI Prototyping Studio, Whisper reading-flow, and BTE X-Ray copy audits may supply source leads. Return the robot-talk format plus one verified compact truth record per project: felt problem, recognizable domain act, what exists now, honest limit, why it could matter, trajectory, current proof, who could help, concrete contribution, and safe/forbidden claim. Derive a 10-second opening, 30-second preview, and deep-detail field grammar without flattening every project into generic AI language. Identify unresolved authority/name conflicts and exclude private or unverified prose from public-ready recommendations. Do not write final marketing copy. Initial position and final post-discussion position must remain distinct for synthesis.

agents.angle: Empirical jobs-to-be-done research over contributor recruitment, open-source onboarding, creative communities, and opportunity navigation; build a decision-first alternative to the project grid.
agents.initial_prompt: You are Lane A's recruitment-decision explorer. Hold the problem fixed: a visitor needs to discover which project matters to them, trust what is real, and see a bounded way to help without reading fourteen specifications. Do not assume the first screen should be a project grid. Research current primary or authoritative sources for open-source contributor onboarding, creative-collaboration recruitment, community project showcases, talent/opportunity navigation, and calls for contribution. Compare project-first, problem-first, role/skill-first, domain-first, and ask-first entry routes. Return the robot-talk format plus a decision journey, CTA ladder, trust-signal matrix, abandonment risks, and a genuine decision-first alternative that can be compared with Lane Z. Specify what a writer, musician, designer, developer, researcher, or curious listener must know before opening detail and before volunteering. Distinguish interest, contact, and commitment; do not invent matching automation, operational workflows, or proven conversion. Include current citations and at least one pattern that succeeds for recruitment but damages explanation or live presentation. Initial position and final post-discussion position must remain distinct for synthesis.

Reconcile Lane Z and Lane A against this solution-independent problem: a Co-Op visitor needs to understand which projects matter, trust what is real, and see a concrete way to contribute without reading fourteen mini-specs or being sold finished products. Do not average the lanes. State what each solves, where each fails, and issue a local bridge decision per major pattern: borrow-carefully, analogy-only, block, promotion-candidate, or future-work. Produce a candidate research substrate with: (1) sourced precedent matrix; (2) audience and decision journey for technical builders and domain practitioners; (3) recommended landing-page hierarchy and a genuine alternative; (4) overview-to-project-detail route model, URL/back/deep-link and mobile/keyboard behavior; (5) a 10-second/30-second/deep-detail content grammar; (6) one source-bounded opening-content map for each of the fourteen projects, preserving distinctive domain language; (7) live-presentation storyboard using the same facts; (8) recruitment CTA ladder that distinguishes curiosity, offer, contact, and commitment; (9) visual and interaction direction stated as principles and evidence, not screenshot taste; (10) a Whisper intake substrate with intent, audience, felt problem, reveal, concrete act, proof, limit, trajectory, ask, forbidden claims, term bridges, and no-meta-narration constraints; (11) acceptance research covering black-box browser behavior, conversational-AI/chat terminology and copy, ease of understanding/coherence, cold-reader retellability, and recruitment-decision clarity; (12) open decisions and evidence gaps. Cite explorer evidence for every load-bearing claim. Inventory is non-authority. Do not redesign the Co-Op meeting, create an exchange state machine, or author final marketing copy.

groups.anti_bias: attack-vector. Popper runs precedent ownership while Taleb runs hand-built non-vacuity witnessing on the attack-vector axis; a bias in Popper toward source similarity would be exposed by Taleb's demand for a usable decision path. Popper runs precedent ownership while Quine runs definitional collapse on the attack-vector axis; a bias in Popper toward borrowed labels would be exposed by Quine's test for a renamed portfolio or slide deck. Taleb runs hand-built non-vacuity witnessing while Quine runs definitional collapse on the attack-vector axis; a bias in Taleb toward a clickable demo would be exposed by Quine if the demo changes no visitor decision or merely re-skins familiar patterns.

agents.angle: Precedent gate: verify the actual owners and primary sources behind portfolio, progressive-disclosure, presentation, recruitment, and comprehension patterns.
agents.initial_prompt: Apply only the precedent gate to the synthesis. Independently verify actual owners and current primary sources for the recommended portfolio/index-detail pattern, presentation behavior, recruitment calls-to-action, narrative movement, and comprehension testing. Label each major mechanism already-deployed, build-from-owned, or precedent-clean/novel-attempt; precedent never emits KILL. Check that the synthesis treats the earlier Co-Op Experiment Exchange result as a typed negative rather than authority for this corrected goal, and that Inventory matches are independently verified. Preserve an explicit source-to-recommendation table and surface weak analogies. Return an initial and final robot-talk position.

agents.angle: Non-vacuity gate: force a hand-buildable overview-to-detail-to-contribution witness that works both self-guided and projected.
agents.initial_prompt: Apply only the non-vacuity gate. Force the smallest concrete witness: one landing opening, at least three sharply different project previews, one full project detail, a deep link/back path, one live-presentation sequence, and one honest contribution action. Test it with a technical builder and a domain practitioner. Require observable black-box browser checks plus human retellability and a decision question; screenshots or schema validity alone do not count. KILL any candidate that cannot show what the visitor understands, what they choose next, and which claim remains bounded. Include one known-bad and one false-positive fixture and return an initial and final robot-talk position.

agents.angle: Definitional-soundness gate: reject renamed portfolios, slide decks embedded in pages, generic AI copy, and cleverness that obscures project truth.
agents.initial_prompt: Apply only the definitional-soundness gate. Test whether the recommendation collapses into an ordinary portfolio grid, a slide deck hidden in a website, a jobs board, a generic AI-project gallery, or a long specification with animation. KILL tautological or re-skinned candidates. Define the meaningful distinctions among opening, preview, detail, live mode, recruitment ask, interest, contact, and commitment. Audit 'brief but detailed and clever' so cleverness means precise framing, contrast, or memorable concrete language rather than hype, mystery, puns, or jargon. Reject assistant coaching, canned transitions, meta-narration, anthropomorphic AI, unearned agentic/knowledge-graph claims, and uniform prose that erases writers', musicians', designers', and developers' domain acts. Return a repaired term/claim table plus initial and final robot-talk position.

Write findings.md only from the converged synthesis and reviewer verdicts. Lead with a direct answer to how the Co-Op project presentation/recruitment page should work. Include: solution-independent problem; Lane Z/Lane A comparison; bridge decisions; precedent matrix; verdict matrix with owner/witnessed/sound/verdict; audience decisions; recommended overview and navigation; overview-to-detail route model; 10-second/30-second/deep-detail content grammar; one source-bounded opening-content map for all fourteen projects; live-presentation storyboard using the same facts; recruitment CTA ladder; visual/interaction principles; Whisper intake substrate and copy guardrails; safe and forbidden claims; black-box browser test plan; conversational-AI/chat-term and copy audit; ease/coherence and cold-reader retellability protocol; alternative design; unresolved decisions; typed negatives; and next lifecycle route. Keep current facts, inferences, and proposals separate. Do not write final marketing copy, redesign the meeting, or imply implemented/recruitment evidence. The strategist, not the writer, appends research.md.

Audit findings.md only against the corrected goal. Recommend acceptance only if the Co-Op Engine is treated as an existing meeting and the researched product is its project showcase/recruitment artifact; Lane A is genuinely different from a project-first grid; every named project has a source-bounded opening-content map; the result explains overview, progressive detail, live use, recruitment, and the meaning of brief/substantial/clever; all load-bearing claims are cited or labeled inference; the verdict matrix follows precedent/non-vacuity/definitional rules; public/private and present/proposed boundaries hold; technical and domain-practitioner audiences are both served without generic jargon; the artifact remains one truth source; and black-box UI, chat/copy, coherence, and human retellability evidence are separated. Ensure the output is substrate for Whisper and later Invoke, not final copy or implementation. Return RECOMMEND_ACCEPT or one bounded revision request; the parent remains final approver under the live registrar.
